+#
+# Generate strict config files for profiles (cfgs/profile/)
+# Returns: 0 on success, 1 if files changed (when fail_on_change=1)
+#
+do_gen_profile_cfgs() {
+  echo "Generating profile config files in cfgs/profile/"
+  local cfgs_dir="${UDB_ROOT}/cfgs/profile"
+
+  # Capture the state before generation
+  local before_hash=""
+  if [ -d "$cfgs_dir" ]; then
+    before_hash=$(find "$cfgs_dir" -type f -name "*.yaml" -exec md5sum {} \; | sort | md5sum | awk '{print $1}')
+  fi
+
+  "${UDB_ROOT}"/bin/bundle exec rake gen:cfg
+
+  if [ $fail_on_change -eq 1 ]; then
+    local after_hash=""
+    if [ -d "$cfgs_dir" ]; then
+      after_hash=$(find "$cfgs_dir" -type f -name "*.yaml" -exec md5sum {} \; | sort | md5sum | awk '{print $1}')
+    fi
+
+    if [ "$before_hash" != "$after_hash" ]; then
+      echo "[ERROR]: Profile config files changed during generation"
+      return 1
+    fi
+  fi
+  return 0
+}

+= Profile Configurations
+
+Configs in `cfgs/profile` are generated from the specifications in `spec/std/isa/profile`.
+They are partial configurations that represent a profile-compliant implementation.
+
+The profile configurations are _strict_.
+That is, they list the extension/params listed in the profile spec,
+plus any extensions/params that are required transitively (e.g., A requires Zaamo and Zalrsc)
+
+The strict configs are compatible with non-strict configs (simply more expressive).
